title: Acceptance check
description: One task's acceptance check at runs/acceptance/<task-id>/check.json. It is written from the task statement and the repo at the start commit only, and frozen before any replay of the task. Each file's content is at runs/acceptance/<task-id>/files/<path>.

author.description: Model id, or person when a person wrote it.

inputs.description: What the author read. No gold patch, test patch, or dataset test lists.

files.description: Repo-relative paths the runner writes into the checkout before it runs the command.

command.description: Run with bash in the repo root. Exit 0 is pass.
